# Wave Link (legacy) triggers

## Filter added

Runs when a filter (effect) is added to an input in Wave Link. This is for the older Wave Link 1.x/2.x and does not run with Wave Link 3.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which input (channel) to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every input. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%filter.name%` | The filter's name |
| `%filter.active%` | true if the filter is on |
| `%filter.id%` | The filter's ID |
| `%input.name%` | The input it belongs to |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.legacy.filterAdded`</small>

## Filter bypass state changed

Runs when a filter bypass (skipping all filters on an input) is switched on or off. This is for the older Wave Link 1.x/2.x and does not run with Wave Link 3.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which input (channel) to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every input. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%filter.name%` | The filter's name |
| `%filter.active%` | true if the filter is on |
| `%filter.id%` | The filter's ID |
| `%input.name%` | The input it belongs to |
| `%waveLinkFilterBypassed%` | true if the filters are skipped now |
| `%mixer%` | Local (Monitor Mix) or Stream |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.legacy.filterBypassStateChanged`</small>

## Input level meter changed

Runs while Wave Link reports the sound level of its inputs. Switch level meters on at the Wave Link page first. This is for the older Wave Link 1.x/2.x and does not run with Wave Link 3.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Meter names** | Names or IDs of the meters to watch, separated by commas. Leave empty for every meter. |
| **Minimum level (0-100)** | Only run when the meter is at least this loud, from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest). Leave empty to ignore how loud it is. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%waveLinkLevelName%` | The name of the loudest matching meter |
| `%waveLinkLevelType%` | Its kind: channel, mix, input or output |
| `%waveLinkLevelLeft%` | Left loudness (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkLevelRight%` | Right loudness (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkLevelPeak%` | The louder of left and right (0-100) |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.legacy.inputLevelMeterChanged`</small>

## Input mute changed

Runs when an input is muted or unmuted in Wave Link. This is for the older Wave Link 1.x/2.x and does not run with Wave Link 3.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channels** | Which input (channel) to watch: its name as Wave Link shows it, like "Music", or its ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every input. |
| **Mixes** | Only react to this mix: "Monitor Mix" or "Stream Mix". Leave empty for both. |
| **State** | Muted: only when it became muted. Not muted: only when it became unmuted. Any: both. Options: Any, Muted, Not muted. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%input.name%` | The input's name |
| `%input.identifier%` | The input's ID |
| `%mixer%` | Local (Monitor Mix) or Stream |
| `%input.local.muted%` | true if muted in the Monitor Mix |
| `%input.local.volume%` | Volume in the Monitor Mix (0-100) |
| `%input.stream.muted%` | true if muted in the Stream Mix |
| `%input.stream.volume%` | Volume in the Stream Mix (0-100) |
| `%waveLinkMuted%` | true if it is muted now |
| `%waveLinkMixName%` | Monitor Mix or Stream Mix |

<small>Type id: `wavelink.legacy.inputMuteChanged`</small>

## Microphone balance changed

| --- | --- |
| **Input devices** | Which microphone to watch, by name or ID. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every microphone. |

| `%microphone.lowCut%` | true if low cut is on |
| `%microphone.clipGuard%` | true if Clipguard is on |
| `%microphone.gainLocked%` | true if the gain is locked |
